business_problem: Fujitsu Limited is building and operating DXP Cloud, a global in-house IT cloud platform, to strengthen security governance. The globally integrated platform provides a cloud environment with security implemented in a speedy manner to realize both safety and security, as well as convenience.
solution_summary: Fujitsu Limited is building and operating DXP Cloud, a global in-house IT cloud platform, to strengthen security governance. The globally integrated platform provides a cloud environment with security implemented in a speedy manner to realize both safety and security, as well as convenience. The company's DXP Cloud operates on Microsoft Azure. This next-generation platform was built in a short timeframe by leveraging Azure's features and services, including framework-based design, process improvement, agile development, zero-trust, operational sophistication, and the use of generative AI. The success of the project was supported by Microsoft Unified Support and Support for Mission Critical (SfMC), which provided upstream and operational support, as well as enhanced solutions such as Azure Rapid Response and Developer Support. DXP Cloud continues to improve and evolve with this support.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud platform that hosts the solution's data processing, analytics, and managed services.

solution_components.name: Azure DevOps
solution_components.role: Coordinates source control, work tracking, and delivery automation for the platform.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Entra ID
solution_components.role: Handles identity and access controls for the modern workplace environment.

business_outcome: Users reported that the security application process, which used to take five days to complete, is now completed immediately with DXP Cloud, and Fujitsu has also achieved as little as three weeks from design to release in some agile delivery cycles.
metrics: In some cases, Fujitsu has been able to achieve a minimum of three weeks from design to release by fine-tuning the units that provide value to users.
Users appreciated that the security application process, which used to take five days to complete, was completed immediately with DXP Cloud.
architecture_clues: DXP Cloud runs on Microsoft Azure with cloud-native networking and zero-trust-oriented security controls.
Fujitsu aligned the platform against the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure and uses Value Stream Mapping to remove friction from platform delivery.
Microsoft advice on using Azure DevOps with SAFe reduced management costs, while Azure Event Hubs and Azure Container Apps are examples of services adopted on the platform.
